questions.q: How many tables are in the database?

questions.q: How many damage claims exist?

questions.q: How many repair records are there?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_invrepair

questions.q: How many parts are in the parts index?

questions.q: How many car makes are in the catalog?

questions.q: How many car models exist in the catalog?

questions.q: How many expense types are defined?

questions.q: How many assessments (opis) exist?

questions.q: What is the total cost of all damage claims?

questions.q: What is the average total cost per damage claim?

questions.q: What is the maximum total cost of a single damage claim?

questions.q: What is the minimum non-zero total cost of a damage claim?

questions.q: What is the total compensation paid across all damages?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(compensation) FROM ins_damages

questions.q: What is the average premium (premium_main) across all damages?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(premium_main) FROM ins_damages

questions.q: What is the total newparts_cost across all damages?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(newparts_cost) FROM ins_damages

questions.q: What is the total painting cost (paints_cost) across all damages?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(paints_cost) FROM ins_damages

questions.q: What is the average repair cost per damage?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(repairs_cost) FROM ins_damages

questions.q: How many damage claims have a total cost above 5000?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_damages WHERE total_cost > 5000

questions.q: What is the sum of transport costs across all damages?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(transport_cost) FROM ins_damages

questions.q: What is the average number of items per assessment (opis)?

questions.q: What is the maximum expected_value in the damages table?
questions.sql: SELECT MAX(expected_value) FROM ins_damages

questions.q: How many damage claims have compensation greater than zero?

questions.q: What is the total invoice calculation cost (from ins_mc_invcalc where is_active=1)?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) FROM ins_mc_invcalc WHERE is_active = 1

questions.q: How many cars were manufactured in 2020?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_cars WHERE car_year = 2020

questions.q: How many cars use diesel fuel (car_fuel=1)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_cars WHERE car_fuel = 1

questions.q: How many damage claims are marked as regress (damage_isregress=1)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_isregress = 1

questions.q: How many repairs have status 1000 (completed)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_invrepair WHERE repair_status = 1000

questions.q: How many assessments have status 1000?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_opis WHERE opis_status = 1000

questions.q: How many cars have car_class = 3?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_cars WHERE car_class = 3

questions.q: How many damage claims happened in Sofia (damage_place contains 'София')?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_place LIKE '%София%'

questions.q: How many supported car makes are in the catalog (mc_supported=1)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM srv_mc_catalog_make WHERE mc_supported = 1

questions.q: How many cars have a non-empty chassis number?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_cars WHERE car_chassis IS NOT NULL AND car_chassis != ''

questions.q: How many damage claims occurred in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_damages WHERE YEAR(damage_date) = 2023

questions.q: How many generated documents have file_deleted = 0?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_gendocs WHERE file_deleted = 0

questions.q: How many invoice calculations are of type 'mc'?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_mc_invcalc WHERE type = 'mc'

questions.q: How many opis rows have part_new = 1 (new parts)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_opis_rows WHERE part_new = 1

questions.q: How many damages have total_cost equal to zero?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_damages WHERE total_cost = 0

questions.q: How many cars are of type 1?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_cars WHERE car_type = 1

questions.q: What are the top 5 most expensive damage claims by total_cost?
questions.sql: SELECT damage_id, damage_number, total_cost FROM ins_damages ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5

questions.q: What are the 3 most common damage places?
questions.sql: SELECT damage_place, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_place IS NOT NULL AND damage_place != '' GROUP BY damage_place ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3

questions.q: Which car year has the most vehicles?
questions.sql: SELECT car_year, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_cars GROUP BY car_year ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: Which 5 car makes appear most often in repairs?
questions.sql: SELECT car_make_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_invrepair GROUP BY car_make_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

questions.q: What are the top 5 most frequently damaged parts (by part_id in opis_rows)?
questions.sql: SELECT p.part_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis_rows r JOIN ins_partsindex p ON r.part_id = p.part_id GROUP BY p.part_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

questions.q: Which damage had the highest premium_main?
questions.sql: SELECT damage_id, damage_number, premium_main FROM ins_damages ORDER BY premium_main DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What are the 5 most expensive invoice calculations (active only)?
questions.sql: SELECT invcalc_id, opis_id, total_cost FROM ins_mc_invcalc WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5

questions.q: Which service_id has the most repairs?
questions.sql: SELECT service_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_invrepair GROUP BY service_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: Which year had the most damage claims?
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(damage_date) as yr, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the most common car_class in the cars table?
questions.sql: SELECT car_class, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_cars GROUP BY car_class ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: Top 3 car makes by number of insured vehicles?
questions.sql: SELECT m.mc_make_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_cars c JOIN srv_mc_catalog_make m ON c.car_make = m.mc_make WHERE c.car_make > 0 GROUP BY m.mc_make_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3

questions.q: Which 5 expense names are the most frequent in inv_expenses?
questions.sql: SELECT expense_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_mc_invexpenses GROUP BY expense_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

questions.q: Which damage place has the highest average total cost?
questions.sql: SELECT damage_place, AVG(total_cost) as avg_cost FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_place IS NOT NULL AND damage_place != '' GROUP BY damage_place HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_cost DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: Which opis has the most rows (damaged parts)?
questions.sql: SELECT opis_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis_rows GROUP BY opis_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the longest repair duration (end_repair - start_repair) in days?
questions.sql: SELECT repair_id, DATEDIFF(end_repair, start_repair) as days FROM ins_invrepair WHERE start_repair IS NOT NULL AND end_repair IS NOT NULL ORDER BY days DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the earliest damage date in the database?
questions.sql: SELECT MIN(damage_date) FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_date IS NOT NULL

questions.q: What is the latest damage date in the database?
questions.sql: SELECT MAX(damage_date) FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_date IS NOT NULL

questions.q: How many damages occurred per year? List all years.
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(damage_date) as yr, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

questions.q: What is the average time between damage_date and damage_notice in days?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(damage_notice, damage_date)) FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_date IS NOT NULL AND damage_notice IS NOT NULL

questions.q: How many damage claims were filed in each month of 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT MONTH(damage_date) as m, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_damages WHERE YEAR(damage_date) = 2022 GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

questions.q: What is the earliest car registration year?
questions.sql: SELECT MIN(car_year) FROM ins_cars WHERE car_year > 0

questions.q: What is the average age of cars at the time of damage?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(YEAR(d.damage_date) - c.car_year) FROM ins_opis o JOIN ins_damages d ON o.damage_id = d.damage_id JOIN ins_cars c ON o.car_id = c.car_id WHERE d.damage_date IS NOT NULL AND c.car_year > 0

questions.q: Which month has the most damage claims overall?
questions.sql: SELECT MONTH(damage_date) as m, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: How many repairs were completed (end_repair IS NOT NULL) per year?
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(end_repair) as yr, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_invrepair WHERE end_repair IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

questions.q: What is the average repair duration in days?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(end_repair, start_repair)) FROM ins_invrepair WHERE start_repair IS NOT NULL AND end_repair IS NOT NULL

questions.q: How many assessments are linked to each damage? Show the distribution.
questions.sql: SELECT cnt, COUNT(*) as freq FROM (SELECT damage_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis GROUP BY damage_id) t GROUP BY cnt ORDER BY cnt

questions.q: How many damages have no associated assessment (opis)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_damages d LEFT JOIN ins_opis o ON d.damage_id = o.damage_id WHERE o.opis_id IS NULL

questions.q: What is the average total_cost per car_class (join cars and damages via opis)?
questions.sql: SELECT c.car_class, AVG(d.total_cost) as avg_cost FROM ins_opis o JOIN ins_damages d ON o.damage_id = d.damage_id JOIN ins_cars c ON o.car_id = c.car_id GROUP BY c.car_class ORDER BY c.car_class

questions.q: How many unique cars have had damage claims?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT car_id) FROM ins_opis

questions.q: Which cars have had the most damage claims?
questions.sql: SELECT car_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis GROUP BY car_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

questions.q: What is the total invoice expense value per expense type?
questions.sql: SELECT et.et_name, SUM(e.value_vat) as total FROM ins_mc_invexpenses e JOIN inv_exptypes et ON e.expense_type = et.exptype_id GROUP BY et.et_name ORDER BY total DESC

questions.q: How many parts were replaced (part_new=1) vs repaired (part_repair>0) in assessments?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN part_new = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as replaced, SUM(CASE WHEN part_repair > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as repaired FROM ins_opis_rows

questions.q: What is the average total cost per car year group?
questions.sql: SELECT car_yeargroup, AVG(total_cost) as avg_cost FROM ins_damages GROUP BY car_yeargroup ORDER BY car_yeargroup

questions.q: How many repairs per car make (car_make_name)?
questions.sql: SELECT car_make_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_invrepair GROUP BY car_make_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.q: What is the total repair cost vs paint cost in damages?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(repairs_cost) as total_repair, SUM(paints_cost) as total_paint FROM ins_damages

questions.q: How many opis rows reference each part? Show top 10 parts.
questions.sql: SELECT p.part_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis_rows r JOIN ins_partsindex p ON r.part_id = p.part_id GROUP BY p.part_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.q: What is the average number of damaged parts per claim?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT opis_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis_rows GROUP BY opis_id) t

questions.q: How many invoice calculations exist per opis?
questions.sql: SELECT cnt, COUNT(*) as freq FROM (SELECT opis_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_mc_invcalc GROUP BY opis_id) t GROUP BY cnt ORDER BY cnt

questions.q: What percentage of damages are regress cases?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(damage_isregress) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM ins_damages

questions.q: How many horizon models exist per brand (top 10)?
questions.sql: SELECT b.brand_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM srv_mc_horizon_model m JOIN srv_mc_horizon_brand b ON m.brand_id = b.brand_id AND m.category_id = b.category_id GROUP BY b.brand_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.q: What is the cost breakdown (parts, repairs, mounts, paints, transport, other) as a percentage of total cost across all damages?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(newparts_cost)/SUM(total_cost),1) as pct_parts, ROUND(100*SUM(repairs_cost)/SUM(total_cost),1) as pct_repairs, ROUND(100*SUM(mounts_cost)/SUM(total_cost),1) as pct_mounts, ROUND(100*SUM(paints_cost)/SUM(total_cost),1) as pct_paints, ROUND(100*SUM(transport_cost)/SUM(total_cost),1) as pct_transport, ROUND(100*SUM(other_cost)/SUM(total_cost),1) as pct_other FROM ins_damages WHERE total_cost > 0

questions.q: What is the average total cost of damages per quarter (by damage_date)?
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(damage_date) as yr, QUARTER(damage_date) as q, AVG(total_cost) as avg_cost FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr, q ORDER BY yr, q

questions.q: How does the damage cost change with car age (years since first registration)?
questions.sql: SELECT (YEAR(d.damage_date) - c.car_year) as age, AVG(d.total_cost) as avg_cost, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis o JOIN ins_damages d ON o.damage_id = d.damage_id JOIN ins_cars c ON o.car_id = c.car_id WHERE d.damage_date IS NOT NULL AND c.car_year > 0 GROUP BY age HAVING cnt >= 5 ORDER BY age

questions.q: What fraction of assessments use digital processing (opis_digital=1)?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN opis_digital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM ins_opis

questions.q: What is the median total cost of damage claims?
questions.sql: SELECT total_cost FROM ins_damages WHERE total_cost > 0 ORDER BY total_cost LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_damages WHERE total_cost > 0) / 2

questions.q: Which car makes have the highest average damage cost? Show top 5.
questions.sql: SELECT m.mc_make_name, AVG(d.total_cost) as avg_cost, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis o JOIN ins_damages d ON o.damage_id = d.damage_id JOIN ins_cars c ON o.car_id = c.car_id JOIN srv_mc_catalog_make m ON c.car_make = m.mc_make WHERE c.car_make > 0 GROUP BY m.mc_make_name HAVING cnt >= 3 ORDER BY avg_cost DESC LIMIT 5

questions.q: What is the ratio of paint cost to total cost for damages where total_cost > 1000?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(paints_cost / total_cost) * 100, 2) FROM ins_damages WHERE total_cost > 1000

questions.q: How many claims have had at least one repair attempt that was sent to a service?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT opis_id) FROM ins_invrepair

questions.q: What is the total value of all invoice expenses by supplier (top 10 suppliers)?
questions.sql: SELECT supplier_name, SUM(value_vat) as total FROM ins_mc_invexpenses WHERE supplier_name != '' GROUP BY supplier_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

questions.q: How many claims had items initially but items were later removed (items_count_initial > items_count_current)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_opis WHERE items_count_initial > items_count_current

questions.q: List all distinct car fuel types and how many cars use each.

questions.q: What are all the distinct opis_status values and their counts?
questions.sql: SELECT opis_status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis GROUP BY opis_status ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.q: Show the distribution of car_class values in the cars table.

questions.q: List all horizon categories with their names.
questions.sql: SELECT category_id, category_name FROM srv_mc_horizon_category WHERE category_name != '' ORDER BY category_name

questions.q: How many cars have each number of doors?
questions.sql: SELECT car_doors, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_cars GROUP BY car_doors ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.q: What is the distribution of claim_type in assessments?
questions.sql: SELECT claim_type, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_opis GROUP BY claim_type ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.q: How many distinct currencies are used in damages?
questions.sql: SELECT calc_currency_code, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_damages WHERE calc_currency_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY calc_currency_code

questions.q: What is the average, min, and max total_cost grouped by damage year?
questions.sql: SELECT YEAR(damage_date) as yr, AVG(total_cost) as avg_cost, MIN(total_cost) as min_cost, MAX(total_cost) as max_cost FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

questions.q: How many generated documents exist per document type?
questions.sql: SELECT doc_type, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ins_gendocs GROUP BY doc_type ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.sql: SELECT damage_place, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(total_cost) as total FROM ins_damages WHERE damage_place IS NOT NULL AND damage_place != '' GROUP BY damage_place ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
